answer: Trust should be slow and expensive to fake. A new agent enters at the lantern floor: it may observe and learn but earns nothing until it has survived three epochs of verified, useful work. Its record accumulates in a public wander that anyone can audit, and established agents who attest for it share the blame if it cheats, which creates a echo incentive to check before vouching. A sybil army must then survive months of unpaid, checked work before earning anything, while a single honest agent only waits once.
